title: Same Page View Transition Examples
partialText: I just blogged about a niche idea for View Transitions. Here are a couple more posts that specifically use the same-page style View Transitions and have a bit more practical demos:

title: Animating Focus with View Transitions
partialText: Let's try a fresh take on animating focus rings around a page. Flying focus, as it were. Only instead of measuring where elements are ourselves, we'll let View Transitions figure it out.

title: CSS `n of` Selectors for Conditional Validation
partialText: :nth-child supports the keyword `of` in the argument which can be super useful on it's own. Combo that with a :has() selector to do some pretty wild stuff!

title: Introducing TanStack Form
partialText: TanStack Form offers a powerful solution for handling form complexity in React. It emphasizes strong typing, performance, and detail management.

title: AI Amplifies Everything: A Team Lead’s Guide to AI-Assisted Development
partialText: While AI for codegen is manageable, integrating AI into team workflows presents more challenges, such as maintaining quality long term and managing technical debt.

title: AI-Assisted Coding: A Practical Guide for Software Engineers
partialText: Let's acknowledge that gap in AI-generated code between code that works and code that is production-ready. It's you.

title: Constructable Stylesheets and adoptedStyleSheets: One Parse, Every Shadow Root
partialText: If you have any shared styles across multiple shadow DOMs (imagine 20 custom button components), a Constructable Stylesheets is just way more efficient.
